description: Sprint 6 ingestion + benchmark corpus. Ten open-access arXiv papers in ML/NLP, chosen because they are textually rich, structurally varied (4 to 75 pages), and cover distinct enough topics that a retrieval query for one should not be satisfied by another. The PDFs are not checked in; this manifest plus scripts/fetch_corpus.py reproduces them byte-for-byte via the pinned SHA-256.
license_note: arXiv PDFs are downloaded for local research use. Individual papers carry their own licenses; this corpus is not redistributed with the repository, which is one reason the PDFs are gitignored rather than committed.

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
